anomalies.description: A collision occurs between a white sedan and a dark-colored SUV around frame 4 (timestamp ~18:03:20). The white car appears to swerve sharply into the path of the oncoming SUV, resulting in a visible impact—both vehicles show sudden deceleration and change in trajectory. Debris is not clearly visible due to low resolution and motion blur, but the abnormal vehicle behavior (sudden lane incursion and contact) strongly indicates a road accident.

No visible debris or fire, but the abnormal vehicle behavior (sudden stop, deviation, and traffic disruption) strongly indicates a road accident.

No debris is clearly visible due to low resolution and motion blur, but the abrupt change in vehicle trajectory and contact confirm a crash.
